# DOSBox text-mode font

The 4096-byte mode3 BIOS font in web/iscore-font16.mjs was extracted from DOSBox0.74-3 using BIOS INT10 AX1130 BH6. Its bytes have SHA256 c7dd5990fa5401649cf69e9bbb4c8a51f86865939b9318281a27de7f314eda3a. DOSBox copyright and GPLv2 text are retained beside this file. The editable generated font module is shipped with the browser assets; capture source and emulator provenance are retained in research/editions/other-worlds-iscore.
